recalled.text: CASE-0001 | 2025-03-12 | Vendor: Deccan Freight Lines (V-1004) | Exception: PRICE_MISMATCH. Invoice DFL/25/0731 billed Rs. 104,000 against PO-5521 Rs. 100,000 (+4.0%). Resolution: APPROVED by Priya Nair. Reason: 'Fuel surcharge up to 5% is covered by the contract amendment.' Applies to: this vendor, price variance up to 5%. Outcome: paid.

CASE-0003 | 2025-03-20 | Vendor: Deccan Freight Lines (V-1004) | Exception: PRICE_MISMATCH. Invoice billed +4.5% over PO. Resolution: APPROVED by Priya Nair. Reason: 'Surcharge up to 5% per contract.' Applies to: this vendor, price variance up to 5%. Outcome: paid.
Deccan Freight Lines (V-1004) bills a fuel surcharge of up to 5% above PO on most shipments, per contract amendment.
Priya Nair never auto-approves an invoice above Rs. 2,50,000 and prefers to email the vendor before rejecting an invoice.

decision.rationale: Same vendor, same exception type. Approved twice before at under 5% (CASE-0001, CASE-0003), and this invoice is +3.8%, inside that range. The vendor profile confirms the surcharge is covered by contract.
